subset_description: EDDI 3-month and monthly reference ET from the NOAA PSL EDDI time-series master table for latitude 39.75 to 39.875 and longitude -105.0 to -104.875.
citation: Hobbins, M. T., A. Wood, D. McEvoy, J. Huntington, C. Morton, M. Anderson, and C. Hain (2016), The Evaporative Demand Drought Index. Part I.
notes: Retrieved through the NOAA PSL time-series tool using monavg=1 and monend=0; the table baseline is 1979-2023.
